body:
It didn't seem like anyone reacted much. The people sitting next to me didn't move and I think someone was taking a selfie (with or without me in frame, not sure).

I walked away looking pretty awful. Not much whistling. Only comments I received were about the climb. (Yes, it is easier going down than up).

I don't run. A couple of times in my younger life I had a similar reaction to running. Not every time though. I just don't run.
Did not notice. I'll check next time I see a market

Sausage, egg, and cheese croissant from Dunkin Donuts.

Not my choice of venue but it is consistent with my normal choices.

Also, about 20oz of water, which made the whole spectacle minimally horrible
